content.reason_to_engage: If retained income from Pay-As-You-Drive Lease covers attributable variable delivery costs and eligible Pay-As-You-Drive Lease customers record completed delivery, the evidence could support further diligence on a repeatable business. content.unresolved_risk: The commercial case weakens if eligible Pay-As-You-Drive Lease customers do not record completed delivery. Equally observed cohorts are needed to identify participation gaps; event logs alone will not establish why customers behave that way.
content.next_decision: Resolve the linked contribution and customer-use questions before recommending an engagement or expansion; investigate adverse results and leave missing inputs unresolved.

content.question_to_explore: What income does the investment entity retain from Pay-As-You-Drive Lease, and does it cover attributable variable service costs?

content.proposed_work: We propose a contribution reconciliation and customer analysis for the Pay-As-You-Drive Lease service. We request your accounting and service-cost records, specifically entity chart and service/fee-sharing agreements, redacted invoices, credit notes, revenue ledger, collection and partner-settlement statements, supplier invoices, direct service/support cost records, and staff-time allocations. The concrete deliverable is a source-linked contribution profit table and a source-linked cohort rate table. This supports the commercial decision to investigate loss-making services, choose pricing or delivery-cost work, and select the next activation or retention investigation before an expansion recommendation. We request redacted account-event and customer/cohort exports for the Pay-As-You-Drive Lease service and the specified activation event, including stable customer keys, event types, timestamps, plan details, and completion/cancellation status, with anonymized customer IDs and dates.
content.invitation: Invite a conversation with one question: Are you available to discuss the data requirements for this analysis?

content.question: What income does the investment entity retain from Pay-As-You-Drive Lease, and does it cover attributable variable service costs?

analysis_plan.question: What income does the investment entity retain from Pay-As-You-Drive Lease, and does it cover attributable variable service costs?

left.name: Recognized service revenue after partner charges, if applicable
left.record_needed: Entity chart and service/fee-sharing agreements; redacted invoices, credit notes, revenue ledger, collection and partner-settlement statements. Exclude customer principal, assets and pass-through taxes from revenue.

left.population: Eligible service accounts, separated by plan and operating month
